name: Smiling Mind
reason: Condition-led mental-health framing, as with Healthy Minds: smilingmind.com.au presents Smiling Mind as an Australian mental-health not-for-profit whose free app is a psychologist-designed 'mental fitness' toolkit, sold on preventing mental ill-health, sleep, managing stress and big emotions, rather than a contemplative or spiritual practice. Robots.txt allows us (Squarespace); contact via its FAQ/help pages. Owner may revisit.
